latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Add fail-closed ISJ deadline FactKernel promotion gate
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: A separate fail-closed ISJ registration-deadline promotion gate now permits the already independently validated materiality-only deadline 2026-10-02 to become eligible for a future FactKernel composition step only when the exact upstream materiality promotion evidence ID and all supporting evidence identities remain unchanged. A separate independent validator recomputes the deterministic FactKernel-promotion evidence ID and proves three tamper cases fail closed. This increment does not alter the existing FactKernel, writer/article, site, social, receipt or acceptance paths and is not yet wired into the runtime orchestrator.
